title: Resize changes stations
music: modern cinematic tech explainer, warm synth arpeggio, soft punchy drums, airy pads, uplifting and confident, 110 bpm

lines.say: The saga routes orders. Every resize goes to the BFF.
With the resize flag on, resizes go to rust-resizer.
Crops still go to the BFF.
Turn the flag off and resizes go back. Check that path.

scenes.sub: Crop stays put. Flag off reverts.
